diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: Densely packed glands with little intervening stroma, forming a lesion cytologically distinct from adjacent and entrapped normal glands.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: Normal glands are not evident, but the extent of gland crowding is diagnostic.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia in secretory phase
legend: Normal endometrium in late secretory phase can have gland area greater than stromal area, creating diagnostic challenges.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia in secretory phase
legend: Increased crowding and cytological distinctiveness from normal background endometrium.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia in secretory phase
legend: Crowded architecturally aberrant glands with a back-to-back arrangement and increased epithelial complexity, with cribriforming. Nuclear atypia is mild.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia with focal squamous metaplasia
legend: Densely packed glands with little intervening stroma, cytologically distinct from adjacent and entrapped normal glands.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia
legend: Normal glands are not evident but the extent of gland crowding is diagnostic.

diagnosis: Endometrial atypical hyperplasia / endometrioid intraepithelial neoplasia with squamous metaplasia
legend: EAH/EIN with variable histologic appearance: some fragments have usual EAH/EIN features while others exhibit extensive (confluent) squamous metaplasia merging with crowded glandular epithelium distinct from adjacent or entrapped endometrial epithelium. In other examples, squamous metaplasia can be more focal, or evident as multiple isolated small morules.
